entities.summary: Laurence Michael Foust was an American basketball player who spent 12 seasons in the National Basketball Association (NBA), most notably with the Fort Wayne Pistons and Minneapolis Lakers. In a twelve-year career, he was a two-time All-NBA Team member and an eight-time All-Star while reaching the NBA Finals five times. His eight All-Star selections is the most in NBA history for an eligible player who has not been selected to the Naismith Basketball Hall of Fame.
